messages:
Maria G.: VerdantAI just sent their upstream license. They allow commercial use but explicitly bar redistribution of 'packaged binary weights' except via escrow or authorized mirrors. SteelEdge wants to ship devices with model pre-loaded. Thoughts?
Jay (Legal): Importantly, "packaged binary weights" language = preinstall prohibited unless we have escrow/mirror permission. We need: (a) written permission for pre-install, or (b) an escrow arrangement + proof of origin/ECCN. I'll ask for an addendum.
Ashwin K.: From runtime/ops side: preinstalled quantized blobs are easiest for partners. Alternatives:
- Escrow pull at first-boot with hash verification (device fetches from escrow mirror).
- Host weights ourselves and provide an OEM-signed image (only if license permits hosting).
- Provide installer that downloads directly from Verdant (BYOW).
Any escrow approach must expose a signed timestamp and digest.
Sophie L.: Product note: marketplace SKU needs a distribution_mode field and gating flags. We should block SKU creation for 'preinstall' unless legal sign-off + escrow URL + ECCN. UX: dropdown: [Hosted by Redwood | Escrow pull at install | BYOW link].
Ravi E.: HW partner POV: SteelEdge's manufacturing flow expects an image we can flash. Escrow pull on first boot is doable but increases support surface (network + firewall rules). They pushed for a one-time provisioning image.
Jay (Legal): If SteelEdge needs a flashable image, that's redistribution. We can try to negotiate a narrow carve-out: Verdant provides a signed sealed envelope (escrow token) that permits SteelEdge to preinstall for a limited batch and accepts liability/indemnity. I'll draft a short addendum template.
Maria G.: Can Verdant provide ECCN and country-of-origin metadata? export-watchdog: please open a review if not provided.
export-watchdog: New case created: EXP-4890 (VerdantAI escrow + ECCN check).
Ashwin K.: Proposal for a minimal escrow manifest we validate during SKU creation:

```
escrow_manifest_version: "1"
model: "verdantai-l2"
escrow_mirror: "https://escrow.verdantai.ai/verdantai-l2/"
signed_digest: "sha256:01ab..."
allowed_preinstall_partners: ["steeledge.serials:LISTORCSV"]
escrow_expiry: "2027-03-01T00:00:00Z"
license_url: "https://verdantai.ai/license-v2"
ECCN: "5D992" # example
```

Ashwin K.: Implement check: if distribution_mode == "escrow-pull" then require escrow_manifest + signed_digest; if distribution_mode == "preinstall-image" require explicit addendum signed by Verdant + partner.
Sophie L.: I'll add gating for ECCN and escrow manifest in the SKU flow. Also add UI help text explaining the difference and operational implications for partners (flashable image vs install-time pull).
Jay (Legal): Draft addendum highlights: narrow-scope permission for preinstall (serial ranges or batch IDs), attribution clause, source-of-origin warranty, export indemnity, and requirement to keep original license attached in product docs. I'll share a redline by EOD.
Maria G.: I'll ping Meera (Verdant partner lead) and ask for the escrow manifest + ECCN. Meera's email: meera@verdantai.ai.
Ravi E.: Noted. SteelEdge will accept escrow-pull as long as we provide an OEM installer. Also need sample firewall rules for manufacturing sites.
Ashwin K.: Ops to draft a small installer that supports: 1) fetch from escrow URL, 2) verify signed_digest, 3) atomically install model, 4) log provenance to device TPM. Will prototype.
Jay (Legal): Also flag: if ECCN requires license for export we must block any global marketplace listing until export team clears it.
Maria G.: Action items: Jay -> addendum draft; export-watchdog -> EXP-4890; Ashwin -> escrow installer prototype; Sophie -> SKU gating + UX copy; Ravi -> manufact firewall checklist; Maria -> request manifest + ECCN from Verdant.
Sophie L.: :white_check_mark: Will update product checklist doc and add a new SKU template 'escrow-pull image'
Maria G.: Keeping thread as single source for this path. Will share Verdant reply here.
